Whisper up to twenty words to an adjacent ally and give it 2 Boons on its next Guile or Reason roll for the social task you name.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
One adjacent willing ally who hears and understands you.
Limits
An ally keeps one unused counsel benefit from you; later counsel replaces it.
Type
Skill / Support / Utility

Privately deliver a message of up to twenty words while you and the ally can speak quietly. Name a social task it helps with. The ally gains 2 Boons to its next Guile or Reason roll for that task this scene.
